name: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd.
about: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited engages in refining crude oil and marketing petroleum products in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Downstream Petroleum; and Exploration and Production of Hydrocarbons. The company operates fuel stations that sell motor spirits, high-speed diesel, compressed and liquefied natural gas, automotive liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and lubricants; operate convenience stores, restaurants, and electric vehicle charging facilities; and offer ATM, money transfer, insurance, and vehicle care services. It also provides LPG for domestic, commercial, and metal cutting gas under the Bharatgas brand name; automobile lubricants, such as automotive engine and gear oils, greases, and specialties, as well as industrial lubricants under the MAK brand; jet fuel; and aviation services, including transportation, storage, and intoplane services. verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~-1% a year growth, below the ~25% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
Trades at PE 8 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 12 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 78% a year while PE moved 37 → 8.
